seo_title: First Generation Scholarships for High School Seniors
seo_description: Explore 15 scholarships for first-generation high school seniors with varying awards. Check deadlines and requirements for each listing.
intro: Navigating the path to higher education can be particularly challenging for first-generation high school seniors. With 15 scholarships available in this category, you may find opportunities that can help ease the financial burden of college. Award sizes vary, with amounts generally ranging from $1,000 to $10,000. Be mindful that deadlines for these scholarships differ, so it's important to check each listing promptly to ensure you don’t miss out.
